input.quote: C. Audits. M&I shall cause a third party review of its data processing center, the Operations Center, and related internal controls to be conducted annually by its independent auditors. M&I shall provide without charge to Customer, upon written request, one copy of the audit report resulting from such review. M&I agrees to promptly implement any changes recommended as a result of such audit.
input.rationale: The Agreement grants M&I no audit, inspection or verification right over Customer's usage, licence compliance or systems. Every audit/examination provision runs in our favour or is neutral: § 21.8(C) (p0277) obliges M&I to procure an annual independent third-party review of its own data centre, to give us a free copy of the report and to implement the recommendations; § 21.8(B) (p0276) and § 17.1 (p0243) preserve our regulators' and auditors' access to records held by M&I. Because there is no audit right binding Customer, there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to constrain, and the position is at or better than preferred — inserting audit parameters would only create a vendor right that does not exist today. Two Customer-burden points are worth noting commercially but are not AUDIT deviations and are not redlined: § 21.8 (p0274) requires us to reimburse M&I's reasonable costs of a regulatory examination performed solely to examine Services used by us, and § 21.7(C)(ii) (p0273) requires us to provide evidence on request that the Agreement is properly reflected on our books and records — a one-off representation-support obligation with no inspection or system-access element.
